dispute_ticket.description: Your useless driver kept me waiting forever and then you people charge ME S$4 for cancelling. What kind of rubbish company is this? Idiots. I am going to tell everyone I know to delete your app. Refund my S$4 right now or I will keep leaving one-star reviews on every platform.

chat_logs.content: where the hell are you?? are you stupid or what, I'm going to be late
Sorry, very heavy jam at Ayer Rajah, about 8 more minutes.

app_events.details: Driver assigned; arrival time shown to rider 08:15:00.
Rider cancelled; driver had not arrived (about 1.9 km away).
Cancellation fee S$4.00 charged to rider.

cancellation_fee.text: The cancellation fee in SGD charged to a rider who cancels after the driver has accepted.

driver_late_waiver_min.text: Minutes beyond the arrival time shown at assignment after which the rider can cancel with no fee payable. The cancellation must be MORE than this many minutes after the shown arrival time.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The arrival time shown at assignment was 08:15:00. The rider cancelled at 08:31:20, which is 16 min 20 s past it, more than the 10-min limit in this trip's policy, so no cancellation fee was payable and the S$4.00 charged at 08:31:22 is refunded in full. The driver's 08:24:40 message blames a jam and GPS shows him still about 1.9 km away. The rider's insults ('stupid', 'idiots', 'rubbish') and his talk of bad reviews are rude but contain no personal advance and do not change the numbers.
